channel.title: Cameroon - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Cameroon, every source cited.

item.title: Cameroon secures 215.9 million euros from Green Climate Fund
item.description: The country's Ministry of Economy, Planning and Territorial Development is now accredited to implement climate projects.

item.title: Cameroon suspends opposition party for three months
item.description: Four opposition parties condemn the decision by the Minister of Territorial Administration, Paul Atanga Nji.

item.title: Blaise Kengne leads Barry Callebaut Cameroon
item.description: Kengne returns to Cameroon after leading Nigerian operations to head SIC Cacaos and Barry Callebaut Cameroon.

item.title: Cameroon secures €87 million for cocoa and coffee
item.description: The Green Climate Fund approved financing for a six-year program to boost agricultural output across five regions.

item.title: Cameroon power link to Chad costs CFA145 billion
item.description: Revised estimate covers 426km of transmission lines and substations for electricity exports.
